title: Remote Work Policy 2027
content:
DEMO DATA -- FOR ILLUSTRATION PURPOSES ONLY.

Remote Work Policy -- Acme Corp
Effective: 2027-01-01 | Reviewed: 2027-08-15

1. Eligibility
   All full-time employees who have completed their 90-day onboarding
   period are eligible to apply for remote or hybrid work arrangements.

2. Core Hours
   Employees must be available and responsive between 10:00 and 15:00
   in their team's primary time zone, Monday through Friday.

3. Equipment
   Acme provides a standard laptop and peripherals. A one-time home-office
   stipend of $800 is available for eligible employees.

4. Security
   All remote work must use the company VPN. Personal devices may not
   be used for accessing internal systems without prior IT approval.

5. Review
   Remote arrangements are reviewed annually. Managers may request
   additional in-office days for onboarding, team sprints, or client visits.

Approved by: People & Culture
Date: 2027-08-15
